''(Remaining matches cancelled)'' | runners-up = }} The '''2021 V.League 1''' (known as the '''LS V.League 1''' for sponsorship reasons) was the 38th season of the [[V.League 1]], the highest division of [[Football in Vietnam|Vietnamese football]] and the 21st as a professional league.{{cite web|title= V.Leagues sign three year sponsorship deal|url= https://vietnamnews.vn/sports/836355/vleagues-sign-three-year-sponsorship-deal.html|website=vietnamnews.vn |access-date=25 December 2020}}{{cite web|title=V.League 1 opening fixtures released|url=https://vietnamnews.vn/sports/828096/vleague-1-opening-fixtures-released.html|website=vnexpress.vn |access-date=21 December 2020}} The season was paused for a third time on 6 May 2021 due to an outbreak of the delta variant of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam|coronavirus]] in the country.{{cite web|title=V. League 2021 suspended after players' indirect contact with suspected Covid case|url=https://e.vnexpress.net/news/sports/football/v-league-2021-suspended-after-players-indirect-contact-with-suspected-covid-case-4273928.html|website=vnexpress.vn |access-date=1 August 2021}} Despite attempts to re-start the season by late November,{{cite web|title= V.League to return in late November|url=https://vietnamnews.vn/sports/1000854/vleague-to-return-in-late-november.html|website=vietnamnews.vn |access-date=1 August 2021}} after a meeting with all teams on August 21, the season was officially cancelled, with no champion determined, and no teams to be relegated; the slots for the [[2022 AFC Champions League]] and [[2022 AFC Cup]] was awarded to Hoang Anh Gia Lai and Viettel respectively in November 26. After the cancellation of the league, [[LS Group]] ceased sponsorship due to issues, and [[Panax vietnamensis|Sâm Ngọc Linh Kon Tum]] was chosen as the main sponsor for the [[2022 V.League 1|next season]]. ==Competition format== The league was scheduled to operate in two stages, with the top six teams qualify for the championship group and remaining teams qualify for the relegation group after a single-round robin regular season. The season was cancelled with one matchday left until the completion of the regular season. ==Teams== A total of 14 teams contested the league, including 13 teams from the [[2020 V.League 1|2020 season]] and [[Binh Dinh FC|Topenland Binh Dinh]] promoted from the [[2020 V.League 2|2020 V.League 2 season]].{{cite web|url=https://e.vnexpress.net/news/sports/football/binh-dinh-fc-win-v-league-2-return-to-top-flight-after-12-years-4185625.html|title=Binh Dinh FC win V.
